business_problem: Emccamp Residencial is a Brazilian real estate and construction company with 49 years of history, building homes across a full range of income levels, from affordable first-home developments to high-end properties.
solution_summary: Using Google Cloud AI, Emccamp produces landing pages in four hours compared to three weeks, cutting costs by 96%. Emccamp Residencial is a Brazilian real estate and construction company with 49 years of history, building homes across a full range of income levels, from affordable first-home developments to high-end properties. With dozens of active developments at any given time and a growing ambition to scale the business without proportionally growing its headcount, the company's ability to produce marketing content efficiently is directly tied to its ability to compete. Emccamp had already been using Google Cloud when a new wave of AI capabilities emerged. What stood out was not a single tool, but the maturity of the platform and the pace at which it was evolving. We had been researching for months, looking at what companies in China and Europe were doing differently.

solution_components.name: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application.

solution_components.role: generates high-quality storyboards that preserve visual continuity during pre-production and shot iteration

solution_components.name: Veo

solution_components.name: Text-to-Speech API
solution_components.role: Generates narrated voiceovers and spoken responses for end-user content.

solution_components.role: Provides the reasoning or generation layer used for classification, orchestration, content generation, or analysis.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Runs serverless application services and APIs with automatic scaling for bursty workloads.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Stores large files, lake data, or static assets that feed downstream analytics and applications.
